title: The Nashville Way
description:
Single-dwelling with 4 sleeping rooms (including LR Sofa bed). Full eat-in upgraded Kitchen; fully-renovated bath; Conversation-style living room; 1-1/2 Baths with towels, shampoos,etc. flat-screen televisions; family lounge den; relax or barbeque on the patio. 5 min.from Fontanel Mansion/Restaurant; 10 minutes from Gaylord Opryland Grand Ole Opry;  12 Minutes from Downtown Nashville!

The space
Reopened 2023 Post-COVID! Extremely warm and welcome. Located in a SAFE neighborhood. This space is best suited for adults who enjoy lounging in their 'down time'. No pets or children under 18 can be accommodated.

Guest access
3 Private Bedrooms plus LR Sofa-sleeper; Eat-in Kitchen; Living Room; shared Den, Large Patio/Grill. guest access to 3 bedrooms, 10 beds including sofas, pull out/trundle beds, bunk beds, and daybeds, sofa sleeper. 2 Queen size air mattresses also available 
Full bath upstairs
1/2 Bath downstairs 
Free WiFi included.
Continental Breakfast foods and beverages are provided. Under no circumstances our guest ever permitted to enter or use the private bedroom! An authorized personnel only sign is posted on the private bedroom door.

Other things to note
You will be SO glad you chose us. We promise our warm, welcome space will make you feel Just Like Home!
